units.source_text: 大原女 [5] 或白川女打扮大都相似，像古装玩偶的样子。

en.t: The Ohara women [5] and Shirakawa women were dressed much alike, looking like dolls in old-fashioned costume.

units.source_text: 她们全是穿山上的劳动服，不像是要进城卖东西的模样。

en.t: They were all wearing work clothes for the mountains, and did not look as if they were going into town to sell things.

units.source_text: 可能这就是日本野外或山上的劳动妇女形象吧。

en.t: Perhaps this was the image of working women in Japan's fields and mountains.
